title: Business event envelope
description: Every event a product sends to a shared module (Finance, HR, Payroll). The receiver keeps a unique key on (source_app, organization_id, source_transaction_id), so a retried event is never applied twice. organization_id must equal the 'org' claim of the event token. Sensitive HR and payroll fields (pay, bank details, identity numbers, health) are never allowed in payloads.

event_id.description: Unique per delivery attempt is allowed; idempotency is on source_transaction_id.

source_transaction_id.description: The product's own id for the business transaction, e.g. the sale number. Stable across retries.

payload.description: Validated against the schema for event_type and schema_version.
